newsitem.title: USA: AmEx, Sony in Brazil partnership.
newsitem.headline: AmEx, Sony in Brazil partnership.

text.p: American Express Co said it entered into a partnership with a unit of Sony Corp to launch a new credit card with a rewards feature in the Brazilian market later this year.
American Express said the card will be issued by Sony Card Administradora, a partnership between Sony Comercio e Industria Ltda - Sony Brazil and Sony Finance International in Japan.

American Express said the card id designed for buyers of Sony products in Brazil. Cardholders will have access to the American Express global services network including travel services offices in 130 countries, automated teller machines and mergency travel assistance and card replacement.

"Sony Brazil is pleasd to join forces with the world's leading card company in order to launch an innovative, high quality card that will strengthen customer loyalty to Sony products and services in Brazil," said Takaai Ushio, president of Sony Brazil. "This new card aims at enhancing Sony Brazil's marketing strategy in an increasingly competitive market."
